messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: Increased error rate from reranker-batch endpoint (svc-rerank-prod) — high 5xx and downstream mismatch errors. Triggered at 06:02 UTC. Notified oncall-ml and oncall-sre.

alyssa: I’m on it, grabbing logs. Any customer-facing alerts yet?

devon: Calling out that we’ve seen 502s correlate with vector length mismatch in today's batch job. Might be the nightly embedder bake.

sanjay: Logged the alert — customer impact: some search/rerank requests returning 500 with "vector size mismatch". Roughly 8% of requests in last 5m.

emma: @alyssa I can help with log pulling. Which replicas?

alyssa: Start with rerank-batch-* pods in eu-west-1 and the job-runner that pushes vectors to the store.

caroline: Oncall handoff: I’m just stepping in for a quick triage. Handoff notes: earlier deploy to embedder image v1.4.3 at 03:30 UTC, more small batches at 04:50.

ricardo: I’m watching metrics — latency spike at 05:58 then errors ramped at 06:01. Errors tagged: 502 gateway, 500 internal: "expected vector len 1536 got 1024".

alyssa: copying logs (snip).

alyssa: ```
2026-03-14T06:01:35Z rerank-service [req=abcd] ERROR downstream: vector_size_mismatch expected=1536 observed=1024 stack=...
2026-03-14T06:01:35Z embed-pipeline [job=bn-20260314-04] WARN produced-vector-len=1024 model=embedder-v2
```

devon: That aligns w/ a quantization change in embedder-v2 variant. Yesterday's canary had a new pipeline that truncates padding and switched to shorter context for speed.

sanjay: Hypothesis 1: embedder produced 1024-d vectors intermittently due to fallback quantized kernel on some GPU hosts. Reranker expects 1536.

emma: Hypothesis 2: storage tiering mismatch — older vectors from image v1.3 are 1536 but new job wrote 1024 to s3 path that the batch read loop uses; some workers pick the new path mid-run.

caroline: Hypothesis tracking: list them inline and mark confidence.

alyssa: Hyp1 confidence: high — logs show embed-pipeline produced 1024 explicitly. Hyp2 confidence: medium — we see S3 path rotations but need reads timeline.

ricardo: I’ll pull S3 put/list events and correlate with job timestamps.

oncall-bot: Incident severity: SEV2 — partial customer impact. Auto page to execs if not mitigated in 30m.

devon: Short-term mitigation: roll reranker schema tolerating 1024 vectors (best-effort) or route traffic to older model variant. Which is faster?

alyssa: Fastest: route production traffic away from eu-west-1 to us-east-1 where embedder jobs haven't run. But that impacts latency for EU customers.

emma: Alternative: hotfix reranker to detect vector len and pad with zeros to 1536 (safe but may affect quality).

caroline: We should instrument a temporary defensive check in the request path and emit a metric, then pad. This buys time for a proper rollback.

ricardo: I’ve located the S3 put events — the embed pipeline started writing to prefix s3://embeds/eu/batches/2026-03-14/04 at 04:52 UTC. Multiple hosts produced 1024-d vectors starting at 04:54.

sanjay: Timeline so far: 03:30 deploy embedder v1.4.3, 04:50 batch-run start, 04:54 first 1024 vectors uploaded, 05:58 errors begin, 06:01 alert.

devon: Rollback plan: revert embedder to v1.4.2 images for the batch job. But the batch already wrote bad vectors; reranker will still read them unless we reprocess or route.

alyssa: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Add defensive pad in reranker (quick PR), 2) Remove new embedder batch jobs (cancel ongoing runs), 3) Start reprocessing job for affected prefixes with correct vectorizer.

emma: I can open the PR for pad+metric now, small change. Will push to canary and run quick test.

caroline: Assignments: alyssa -> coordinate rollback/cancel batch; devon -> patch reranker pad PR; ricardo -> S3 and metrics correlation; emma -> deploy and test pad change; sanjay -> customer impact comms; I'll lead the mitigation.

oncall-bot: Escalation timer started (30m).

alyssa: Executing cancellation: `kubectl -n ml delete job embed-batch-20260314-04 --cascade=false` — stopped within 4s.

ricardo: Confirmed job containers terminated across eu-west nodes. No further 1024 puts after 06:08.

devon: PR created: `ml/reranker#412` — adds vector len detection + zero-pad to 1536 and emits metric `reranker.nullpad.count`. Tests added.

emma: Deployed canary of reranker with pad to us-east-1 small cluster. Observed zero-pad behavior and metric emitted when pad applied. No obvious errors at canary.

sanjay: Customer impact update: affected customers (IDs: cust-13, cust-42) saw degraded results. We sent initial incident msg to CSMs at 06:15.

caroline: QA: we should generate a quick synthetic rerank request using sample 1024 vector to measure quality delta.

alyssa: Doing that now. Results: padding recovers responses, rerank score variance small (<2%).

devon: Given this, proceed with rolling pad fix to prod in eu-west with a 10% canary then roll.

emma: Rolling patch to eu-west canary group now.

noncall-bot: Canary metrics summary in 5m.

ricardo: Correlation results: ~67% of 1024 vectors came from three hosts with older CUDA libraries that triggered quantized fallback. We need to fix the runtime config too.

caroline: Root cause working hypothesis: embedder deploy introduced a quantized path on a subset of hosts causing 1024-d vectors to be written; reranker assumed 1536, causing downstream 500s.

sanjay: Impact summary for ops: ~8% requests in eu-west for 24 minutes; visible to 2 paying customers with degraded relevance. No data loss.

alyssa: Post-mitigation: pad rolled, bad batch jobs stopped, reprocess scheduled for tonight to regenerate vectors for affected prefixes.

devon: Next steps: 1) Reprocess all batches written 04:54-06:08 with correct embedder, 2) Rebuild embedder images to lock kernel path, 3) Add integration check on vector dim in storage writer, 4) Add deploy-blocker if any vector dim change without config flag.

caroline: I’ll open the incident ticket and patch the runbook with new checks. Marking RCA in-progress.

sanjay: Customer comms draft: short apology, describe mitigation (pad deployed, reprocess scheduled), ETA for full recovery (24h reprocess). I'll post to CSMs and coordinate status page.

alyssa: Saving logs and timeline to the incident folder: s3://redwood-incidents/2026-03-14/rerank-live-1865432100/logs.tar.gz

ricardo: Adding relevant query snippets for RCA:

ricardo: ```sql
-- find puts of vectors between 04:50 and 06:10
select key, put_ts, vector_len, host from embed_puts where put_ts between '2026-03-14T04:50:00Z' and '2026-03-14T06:10:00Z' and vector_len != 1536;
```

caroline: Tagging this for postmortem. Please add any other hypotheses or evidence in-thread. We’ll assemble timeline and publish RCA doc tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

alyssa: Thanks team — continuing to monitor. If any new 1024 events appear ping here immediately.

oncall-bot: Incident status: mitigated (pad deployed, batch jobs stopped). Auto-close scheduled in 72h unless updated."
